name: ReactomeContent_search
description: Search Reactome for pathways, reactions, and biological entities by keyword. Performs free-text search across Reactome's knowledge base of biological pathways. Supports filtering by species and entity type. Example: searching 'apoptosis' in Homo sapiens returns pathways like R-HSA-109581 (Apoptosis), R-HSA-169911 (Regulation of Apoptosis), R-HSA-9635465 (Suppression of apoptosis). Use this to discover relevant pathways before querying their details. Results are paged: 'count' is how many entries came back, 'total_results' is how many matched in Reactome overall, and 'has_more' flags that the list is a slice -- use 'rows' and 'start' to page through the rest. With grouped (cluster) results, 'rows' applies to each type group; continue with start=next_offset while has_more is true.

query.description: Search query. Examples: 'apoptosis', 'TP53', 'cell cycle', 'DNA repair', 'insulin signaling'.

species.description: Species name for filtering results. Default: 'Homo sapiens'. Other options: 'Mus musculus', 'Rattus norvegicus', 'Danio rerio', 'Drosophila melanogaster'.

types.description: Entity type to search. Options: 'Pathway', 'Reaction', 'Complex', 'Protein', 'SmallMolecule'. Default: 'Pathway'.

rows.description: Number of results to return per page (1-1000). Default 30. Queries often match far more than that ('DNA repair' in Homo sapiens matches 455 pathways), so raise this to see beyond the first page. Compare the returned 'count' against 'total_results' to know how much you are holding.

start.description: Zero-based offset of the first result to return, for paging through large result sets. Use together with 'rows' (e.g. rows=50 with start=0, then start=50). Omit to start at the first result.

limit.description: Alias for rows, used when rows is not given.

offset.description: Alias for start, used when start is not given.

count.description: Number of entries actually returned in 'results' on this page

total_results.description: Total number of results matching the query in Reactome (upstream 'numberOfMatches'), which is usually far larger than 'count'

start.description: Zero-based offset of the first returned entry within the full result set

has_more.description: True when more matching entries exist beyond this page; raise 'rows' or advance 'start' to reach them

is_disease.description: Whether this is a disease-related pathway

summation.description: The paragraph describing the pathway or reaction, which Reactome answers for all 30 entries of a search while the row carried a name

name: ReactomeContent_get_contained_events
description: Get events contained within a Reactome pathway. Returns every resolved sub-pathway plus an explicitly pageable reaction list with true event/pathway/reaction counts and a next offset, so large pathways do not silently stop at 50 reactions.

identifier.description: Reactome pathway stable identifier. Examples: 'R-HSA-109581' (Apoptosis, 177 events), 'R-HSA-69278' (Cell Cycle), 'R-HSA-73857' (RNA Polymerase II Transcription), 'R-HSA-1640170' (Cell Cycle Checkpoints).

reaction_limit.description: Maximum contained reactions to return on this page.

orthologous_events.description: The same event inferred in other species. "This reaction exists in mouse as R-MMU-..." is the answer to half the questions asked of a pathway.

is_disease.description: True when the event is a disease variant of a normal process. A disease reaction mixed into a normal pathway silently changes what the pathway describes.

db_id.description: Reactome's internal numeric id for the event, e.g. 141159. Distinct from the stable 'R-HSA-' identifier, and the one some Reactome endpoints require.

is_disease.description: True when the event is a disease variant of a normal process. A disease reaction mixed into a normal pathway silently changes what the pathway describes.

has_more_reactions.description: True when reactions remain beyond this page.

next_reaction_offset.description: The offset to pass for the next page, e.g. 50.

reaction_limit.description: Page size applied to the reactions, e.g. 50.

reaction_offset.description: How many reactions were skipped before this page, e.g. 0.

reactions_truncated.description: True when the reaction list was cut - true on the measured call, where 50 of 142 came back.

total_reactions.description: How many reactions the pathway contains in total, e.g. 142.

name: ReactomeContent_get_enhanced_pathway
description: Get enhanced pathway details from Reactome including the complete curated description and complete direct literature-reference list, GO biological process terms, and direct sub-events. Reports summary character and literature counts; it does not silently cut summaries at 2,000 characters or references at 20.

identifier.description: Reactome pathway stable identifier. Examples: 'R-HSA-109581' (Apoptosis), 'R-HSA-6804757' (Regulation of TP53 Degradation), 'R-HSA-69278' (Cell Cycle), 'R-HSA-168256' (Immune System).

literature.description: Key literature references with PubMed IDs
